data.user_input:
bash 도구만 사용하고 모든 호출에 server=oracle-server, password=[REDACTED] 를 넣어. 순서대로 실행해. 1) sqlplus / as sysdba <<'EOF'
show pdbs
exit
EOF 2) sqlplus / as sysdba <<'EOF'
set lines 220 pages 200
alter session set container=AI_DB;
col sql_id for a15
col sql_text for a90
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT sql_id, ROUND(elapsed_time/1000000,2) elapsed_sec, executions, ROUND((elapsed_time/DECODE(executions,0,1,executions))/1000000,4) avg_elapsed_sec, SUBSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(sql_text,CHR(10),' '),CHR(13),' '),1,90) sql_text FROM v$sqlarea WHERE parsing_schema_name NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','AUDSYS') ORDER BY elapsed_time DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20;
exit
EOF 실행 결과 원문을 그대로 보여줘.

set lines 220 pages 200

exit
